responsibility: This header declares gm2’s C-side builtin interface: initialization of the builtin table, lookup of builtin constants and type-info names, existence testing for target-supported builtins, and helper constructors for specific builtin calls such as memcpy, alloca, isfinite, and huge_val variants. It is the declaration companion to the builtin registration logic in m2builtins.cc.
same_name_distinction: This header declares the native C/C++ entry points for gm2 builtin lookup, initialization, and helper call builders. It differs from m2builtins.def by serving C/C++ translation units rather than Modula-2 modules, and from m2builtins.cc by containing only prototypes, not builtin tables or registration logic.
